body_html:
GRAMMY Nominated Engineer!

Eric Joins JAMMIN’ DJs from Green Bay Wisconsin and The Minnesota Twin Cities.  He loves to entertain and produce music, and in his off time loves to swim, work out, and cook!

A Message from Eric:  As your DJ, I understand the importance of creating the perfect atmosphere.
My passion for music and my extensive knowledge of different genres and eras enable me to curate a playlist that reflects your unique tastes and personalities.
I have a keen ear for reading the room and can effortlessly transition between different styles of music to keep your guests engaged and entertained.My professionalism and attention to detail ensure that everything runs smoothly, from the first dance to the last song of the night.
I work closely with you to understand your vision for your wedding or event and make sure that everything is executed flawlessly.

Above all, I am committed to creating an unforgettable experience for you and your guests. I pride myself on delivering exceptional service and making sure that everyone has a great time on the dance floor.
Thank you for considering me as your DJ.

I look forward to working with you to make your wedding day or event everything you’ve dreamed of and more!

What’s In Eric’s Headphones:  Pop music, Hip-Hop, Trap, R&B, House, & Afro-Pop
